execution.progress: Paid work in twelve one-round increments whose exact job, reserved pieces, installed parts and site persist across interruption; resume pays only the next increment after revalidation; completion, cancellation, failure and death settle once. Inspect, repair and dismantle are single rounds.

details.costs: Study: 4 rounds. Start: x, y, orientation (degrees; 0 points the low roof edge toward increasing x, where wind comes from) and materials as exact owned, untreated whole units totalling 13 branch, 4 vine and 6 bark; stand within reach of a 2 m x 2 m footprint of ordinary dry soil that is inside the world, unobstructed and unoccupied. Twelve paid increments, one round and 1 energy each: 2 posts, 3 ridge and braces, 3 ribs and binding, 3 roofing courses, 1 final check; start pays the first and the same action continues each round. Resume pays the next increment of the unfinished work; cancel takes one round and no energy. Inspect: target in reach, one round, 0.2 energy. Repair (builder only): target, increment 1-11 and the exact replacement units of that increment, one round, 1 energy. Dismantle (builder only): target, one round and 1 energy per stage, removing the last installed stage. Gathering, travel and probe tests are separate actions with their own costs.
details.effects: Reserved materials stay carried and owned until each paid increment moves them into the structure as installed parts with the same quantity, origin and age; nothing is created or used up. After the final stability, binding, roof-load and runoff checks the shelter is commissioned: a 2 m x 1 m covered floor under a 1.2 m ridge and a roof sloping about 50 degrees. While exactly one person lies wholly on that floor in rain and wind up to 0.8, it removes up to 50% of the rain part and up to 35% of the wind part of the existing outdoor exposure chill, scaled by roof condition, by the share of the body under the roof along the wind-driven rain, and for wind by how directly the low edge faces the wind; wind entering the open side, stronger weather, water pooling on the floor or a second person gives no protection. Air temperature, hunger, nutrition and rest are unchanged, and copies never stack. A frame without its three roofing courses gives no rain protection. Each round installed parts wear by 0.0005 + 0.002 x rain + 0.002 x wind; a part below condition 0.5 makes a commissioned shelter unsafe with no protection until repair and a passing reinspection. Repair restores only the replaced parts; removed and dismantled parts return to the ground at the site with their condition and can be reused at that condition. Work not continued in a round pauses; a lost reserved material stops it. Cancel returns uninstalled materials once and leaves installed parts as an unfinished structure; death stops the work, drops uninstalled materials where the person died and leaves installed parts. No reward, mastery or refund.
